banned.why: every random number comes from a seed: Rng / deriveSeed (@futuremagic/core)
a mesh leaving for good goes through freeMesh (render/materials.ts): its geometry disposed alone, the renderer's render objects kept it through the shared material (MW memory leak)
workers are created by the one worker pool
every material is a kind in the registry, so warm-up knows every shader (docs/SHADERS.md)
shader variants come from the registry's TSL kinds, not from patched source (docs/SHADERS.md)
compiling is the Stage's job (@futuremagic/stage): warmUp() and add() (docs/SHADERS.md)

positionWorld and modelWorldMatrix are relative to the floating origin: patterns, noise and masks read WORLD (src/render/origin.ts); a file that needs the relative value for a distance or a ray is added here (docs/SHADERS.md)

layers.why: the world model is pure data: it runs in workers and headless tests
a setting module is data and pure functions (docs/design/masterworld-plan.md section 12)
the world simulation is pure: it runs in a worker and in headless tests (plan 9.3)
the VGM decides; it does not draw
talk is knowledge and words: pure, so it runs in tests (plan 9.1)
the hero's body, numbers and fights are pure: they run in headless checks (the fight bot)
the renderer does not know about the game
